title: Effective Vibecoding
description: How to direct an AI coding agent well: scoping tasks, prompting clearly, reviewing what it writes, and staying safely in control the whole time.

changelog.notes: Initial release — 27 decks, 194 cards, each pack with a preview card teaching the concept before its graded main card and practice cards.
Glossary: every term now points at one link, so the same word never sends you to two different pages.
Adds Learn more articles (5, each with a worked example) for the glossary terms; tapping a term now offers "Read the full explanation".
Removes the Wikipedia links from glossary terms that have a Learn more article; the article is now the single place to read more.
Rewrites the Learn more articles in a warmer, teacher-to-student voice; no change to the content or the glossary.
Card: one fill-in-the-blank fragment no longer uses code formatting around the blank.
Cards: review fixes. Practice and pack cards now cover their planned keywords, and a few prompts, options and explanations no longer use terms taught later.
